chronology: Original selection protocol and registry were committed/pushed before band mapping. Aggregate selection/band counts were inspected. No empirical optimization, profiles, prediction scores or bootstrap results were inspected before freezing this amendment. Repairs were identified and validated using synthetic fixtures.
unchanged: Source/linkage, band thresholds, selection, whole-label split, models, six prescribed starts, rate bounds, scaling, tolerances, profile grid, evaluation, 200 paired bootstrap draws and all false scientific/engine gates remain unchanged.

optimizer.method: bounded quasi-Newton with finite-domain Armijo backtracking
optimizer.initial_inverse_hessian: identity in scaled coordinates at each prescribed start
optimizer.direction: Minimize the finite convex BFGS quadratic over actual step bounds using L-BFGS-B; its success flag is not used to establish likelihood convergence. If direction is nonfinite/non-descent or Hessian fails, reset and use projected steepest descent.
optimizer.quadratic_ftol_gtol: same frozen outer settings; quadratic supplies direction only
optimizer.invalid_trial: count, return infinity with unavailable (NaN internal) gradient, reject and backtrack; never export NaN or exception payload
optimizer.curvature_update: BFGS inverse update only if s dot y > machine_epsilon*norm(s)*norm(y); otherwise reset identity
optimizer.success: Independent infinity norm of true projected scaled-coordinate gradient <= frozen optimizer_gtol. Zero outward components only at exact zero/cap. ftol records consecutive small relative objective changes but never certifies convergence.
optimizer.failure: Iteration limit, no finite initial objective, exhausted finite descent/representable steps, numerical optimizer failure; no fake converged estimate
optimizer.direct_final_verification: Every candidate uses direct scipy expm/expm_frechet for its published log likelihood and a separate final projected scaled free-gradient KKT check at the original frozen gtol. A fast-search success failing this direct check is retained as failed, not accepted.

kernels.exact_support: Positive-rate graph closure precedes kernels; structurally impossible selected pairs have exact zero likelihood support.
kernels.spectral_roundoff_budget: maximum of 3*machine_epsilon*einsum(abs(eigenvectors),abs(exp(eigenvalues*gap)),abs(inverse_eigenvectors)) and 3*machine_epsilon*cond(eigenvectors)*(1+gap*infinity_norm(Q)); accounts conservatively for eigendecomposition and long-gap accumulation as well as reconstruction
kernels.relative_check: For each used likelihood entry, if probability*probability_tolerance <= estimated reconstruction budget, replace the entire gap matrix and all derivatives with direct scipy expm/expm_frechet.
kernels.fallback: Ill-conditioned/defective, nonfinite or invalid probability/conservation spectral result uses direct kernels. Relative budget is a numerical estimate, not a rigorous error bound.
kernels.design: Same kernels with all probability entries relevant; boundary difference stencil and SVD controls unchanged.
